open.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.

open.message: Yellow-cream background (text #efe6d4, text #efe5d4).
open.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

open.message: 3 typefaces in use (Cinzel, Manrope, Cormorant Garamond).
open.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

open.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
open.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

open.message: No video anywhere on the page.
open.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

open.message: 88 text blocks under 13px.
open.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

open.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
open.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

open.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 640px at 11476px; 492px at 16360px (the screen is 900px tall).
open.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

open.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Three threads" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "from one crocus." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Everything else follows." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Six thousand threads. One name." (screen 2, 100% hidden)
open.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

open.message: Large text is cut off along its top by the box that holds it: "Kashmiri" (screen 6); "Green" (screen 7)
open.fix: Jurors read a wordmark sliced at the top as broken. Give the box room for the ascenders (line-height and padding), or crop at the bottom or a side edge on purpose.

open.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Three threads" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "from one crocus." (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Everything else follows." (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
open.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

open.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Mongra Saffron"
open.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
